user_query: I'm planning a trip with my friends and I want to send them a WhatsApp message to coordinate.

TaskList.description: Check the status of friends' phone numbers to ensure they are active and reachable.
Generate a QR code for your phone number for easy sharing with friends.
Suggest good night messages for you to include in your WhatsApp message.
Send the WhatsApp message to your friends with the QR code and suggested messages.
